cta.description: Extensions: shopify catalog extension active — responses may carry shop-specific enrichment beyond the core spec; `variants[*].url` is the PDP and `variants[*].checkout_url` is the buy-now target; discount extension advertised — cart/checkout may accept `discount_codes[]` and surface `discount_allocations` per line item; run --input-schema before adding discount fields; fulfillment extension advertised — delivery groups may carry richer scheduling/handle metadata than the core spec requires; run --input-schema before adding fulfillment fields. Cross-business results — each variant belongs to its own seller. Pick the seller AND variant the buyer wants (products[N].variants[M]) before proceeding. To create a cart, pass --business=<products[N].variants[M].seller.domain>. If chosen items span multiple seller.domain values, create one cart/checkout per seller. Buyer handoff: open products[N].variants[M].checkout_url for buy-now handoff when the buyer wants business-hosted checkout. More results available; paginate only if you need them.

description.html: Wi-Fi HaLow™ is the designation for products incorporating IEEE 802.11ah technology. Nominal Capacity: 3450mAh, typical Discharge Current: 10A Maximum Continuous Nominal Voltage: 3.6V Maximum Voltage: 4.2V Approximate Dimensions: 18.5mm x 65.3mm Approximate Weight: 48g Specification Datasheet: Sanyo NCR18650GA Datasheet Rated Capacity: This is the total amount of charge a battery can store as determined under controlled conditions, usually specified by the manufacturer. It's often measured under ideal conditions with a specific discharge rate, temperature, and cutoff voltage. The rated capacity is usually determined using standard testing procedures that might not perfectly replicate everyday usage but provide a consistent basis for comparing different batteries. Typical Capacity: This term is less formal and is often used to describe the battery capacity that a user can expect under normal usage conditions, which may differ from the controlled conditions used to determine the rated capacity. Typical capacity can take into account more realistic factors such as variable discharge rates, temperature variations, and aging of the battery. It's an estimate of what users might experience more regularly, thus providing a more practical perspective on the battery's performance. Wi-Fi HaLow™ is the designation for products incorporating IEEE 802.11ah technology. Wi-Fi HaLow™ augments Wi-Fi by operating in spectrum below one gigahertz (GHz) to offer longer range and lower power connectivity. Wi-Fi HaLow™ meets the unique requirements for the Internet of Things (IoT) to enable a variety of use cases in industrial, agricultural, smart building, and smart city environments.
